title.en: An Act Standardizing the Salaries of All the Personnel Constituting the Accounting Group in the National Government.
title.orig: An Act Standardizing the Salaries of All the Personnel Constituting the Accounting Group in the National Government.

text.en:
Any provision of existing law to the contrary notwithstanding, the annual rates of salaries as previously prescribed for the officials and employees in the National Accounting Service of the Budget Commission as well as the department chief accountants, chief accountants, accountants, bookkeepers, supervising accounting clerks, and all other personnel holding position items in the accounting group provided in the appropriations for National Government agencies are hereby Standardized and adjusted so that those who occupy the following existing positions with their corresponding salary ranges shall receive the salaries within the new salary ranges hereinbelow provided:

(z) Accounting Systems Analyst II R-43 (4,860-5,928) R-48 (6,240-7,608) (aa) Accountant II R-43 (4,860-5,928) R-48 (6,240-7,608) (bb) Senior Accounts Analyst I R-43 (4,860-5,928) R-48 (6,240-7,608) (cc) Accounting Systems Analyst I R-41 (4,404-5,376) R-46 (5,640-6,888) (dd) Accountant I R-41 (4,404-5,376) R-46 (5,640-6,888) (ee) Account Analyst R-41 (4,404-5,376) R-46 (5,640-6,888) (ff) Bookkeeper II R-39 (3,984-4,860) R-44 (5,112-6,240) (gg) Supervising Accounting Clerk R-39 (3,984-4,860) R-44 (5,112-6,240) (hh) Bookkeeper I R-37 (3,612-4,404) R-42 (4,632-5,640) (ll) Supervising Cost Accounting Aide R-37 (3,612-4,404) R-42 (4,632-5,640) Provided, That any new appointment to be issued for the positions stated in items (a) to (mm) shall be based on the corresponding step in the new salary range: And provided, further, That no official or employee shall be given an increase in salary as fixed in this Act, which in effect will exceed the salary of his immediate superior.

Except those officials and employees to occupy the positions above-stated, by virtue of an original. appointment or a promotional appointment to a higher position where a new appointment has to be issued and approved by the authorities concerned, the incumbents actually holding the positions above-stated shall continue to occupy their respective positions and receive the adjusted salary rates as provided in this Act without the necessity of issuing a new appointment.

Officials and employees in the accounting group who are actually receiving higher rates of salary than those of similar positions fixed in Section one of this Act consequent to the provisions in the respective special laws pertaining to their agencies, shall continue to occupy their positions and receive the corresponding salary rates fixed in the special laws concerned.

Such sums as may be necessary to cover the salary differentials of the officials and employees provided in Section one hereof are hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated. For subsequent fiscal years, appropriation to cover the salaries as herein fixed shall be provided in the annual General Appropriations Act.
All Acts, executive orders, administrative orders, rules and regulations or parts thereof inconsistent with any of the provisions of this Act, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 4, 1971.
